module.purpose: Defines the shared TypeScript type contracts for the booking creation flow (handleNewBooking) in Cal.com. It centralizes shapes for invitees, payment credentials, fixed/round-robin-aware users, and marketing tracking data consumed by the booking handler logic.
module.summary: This file is a pure type-definition module under the bookings feature's handleNewBooking directory. It imports domain types from i18next, the app-store, payment/availability libs, and Prisma client models, then composes them into booking-specific contracts. The User type is derived from Prisma's userSelect payload with selectedCalendars omitted. Invitee describes an array of attendee details (email, name, timezone, phone, language/translation function). IEventTypePaymentCredentialType describes an event-type payment app credential including appId, app categories/dirName, and a JSON key. IsFixedAwareUser extends the base user with round-robin scheduling metadata: isFixed flag, calendar credentials, organization slug, priority, weight, selected calendars, and availability data. It also re-exports PaymentAppData and defines Tracking for UTM attribution parameters. No runtime code exists here; it exists purely to type the booking creation pipeline.
module.businessContext: Serves Cal.com's core scheduling product: creating bookings with attendees, payment apps, calendar credentials, and marketing attribution. Failures in these contracts would break type-safety across the booking handler, payments, and round-robin scheduling.
classes: Invitee (~L14-25): Array-shaped type describing booking attendee contact and language details
IEventTypePaymentCredentialType (~L27-34): Interface for event-type payment app credential metadata
IsFixedAwareUser (~L36-46): User extended with fixed/round-robin scheduling and calendar attributes
Tracking (~L50-56): Optional UTM marketing attribution parameters for a booking
systemCapabilities: Typing fixed vs round-robin user assignment
